text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Each year it handles more than 2,500 items of business that the departments and the Federal Chancellery present to the Federal Council.", "gist": "The entity handles over 2,500 items annually from departments and Federal Chancellery for the Federal Council."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "It plans the Federal Council meetings, draws up the agenda, runs the joint reports procedure and issues the decisions made by the Federal Council.", "gist": "The entity plans meetings, prepares agendas, manages joint reports, and publishes Federal Council decisions."}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Legal Section", "gist": "A section providing legal support"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "provides support to the Federal Council Affairs Section and is responsible for legislation on administrative organisation, the consultation procedure and publications.", "gist": "The Legal Section must support the Federal Council Affairs Section and handle specific legislation and procedures"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "Official Publications Centre (OPC)", "gist": "A centre for official publications"}]}
